entries.claim: An insecure direct object reference is proven by requesting an identical endpoint under another user's identifier and receiving that user's record instead of a 403/404.
steps: Capture the pre-state with a read-only request and record it.
Perform the single state change.
Read the state again THROUGH THE SAME ACCOUNT and, if a second test identity exists, through that identity too.
A change visible only to the actor proves write access, not a vulnerability. Cross-account visibility is what makes it one.

entries.claim: The system's authorization functionality does not prevent one user from gaining access to another user's data or record by modifying the key value identifying the data.

Fire many parallel attempts (tens to hundreds) so at least one lands inside the window.
